n_rationale: matches the SciFact sample size. maybe is 11% of the data, so n=50 puts only ~6 items in that cell and its recall is directional only; raising n to 500 uses the full official test set and gives 55
retrieval_rationale: no retrieval stage - the abstract sections ship with each item

generation.max_model_len_rationale: one abstract per item rather than five, so 8192 is ample; max_tokens is 256 since the answer is a single word in JSON
